name: Active view name with prefix
request: Make a reusable tool that reports the active view name with a prefix I supply.
description: Reads the active view and returns its name with the requested prefix. No model changes are committed.
source: return new { viewId = doc.ActiveView.Id.Value, label = inputs.GetProperty("prefix").GetString() + doc.ActiveView.Name };

inputs.name: prefix
inputs.description: Text before the native view name.

expectedResult: JSON contains the active native view ID and a label equal to prefix plus its current name.

tests.name: active-view-readable
tests.assumptions: A disposable nonworkshared project with an active view and trusted C# enabled.
tests.expectedResult: The active view has a valid ID and name; the supplied prefix remains literal input data.
